Trump Criticizes International Criminal Court at UN

At the United Nations, U.S. President Donald Trump referred to the International Criminal Court (ICC) as a "rogue institution" and an "evil" entity. He called on nations to quit the court. The U.S. is not a member of the ICC and has not ratified the Rome Statute, which established the court.
